column1: Starting: Sept 2024 | Launch: Nov 2024 | Model: 1 Shelter/Month Onboarding
1. Conservative model assumes 1 shelter onboarded per month
2. Average 50 participants per new shelter, ramping to 75-100 over time
3. Platform fee of 2.5% on all transactions (SmartFund 80-15-5 separate)
4. Sponsorships and white label deals are quarterly, conservative estimates
5. Token staking yields calculated at 7% APY on housing fund accumulation
6. Salary increases for core team in months 13 and 18
7. Break-even achieved month 12, sustained profitability by month 21
8. Model shows path to $500K ARR (Year 1) and approaching $2M ARR trajectory
9. Pre-seed funding of $250K covers runway to profitability + 6 month buffer
10. Scalability improves significantly after month 18 as base grows
